text: The Olympic rings are blue, black and red on top, yellow and green below. How many of the five rings link with exactly two others?
why: Yellow links blue and black, green links black and red, and black links yellow and green. Blue and red link with only one ring each.

text: The Summer Olympics are held every four years, and there was one in 2024. Will there be one in 2050?
why: 2024, 2028 … 2044, 2048, 2052: 2050 isn't a multiple of four years on.
